[IDAT.10.1] **Argument ownership.** By default, arguments
passed by pointer are borrows — the callee reads
them, does not take ownership, does not retain the
pointer beyond the call. A few functions do take
ownership: `ds_json_array_append()` and `ds_json_object_set()`
adopt `child` on success and leave it with the caller
on error. **The name does not tell you** — every one of
these reads like a borrow — so the header comment is
the normative statement of ownership, and a function
that takes ownership of any argument MUST carry one.
